seed_note: Environment, order and custom proposals seeded; OMPL and IK plugin have independent RNG streams. Repeats are paired by environment, not common OMPL random numbers.

analysis.primary_family: Cartesian minus projected matched-success joint and EE path length; two one-sided environment sign tests, Holm correction
analysis.stopping: Fixed sample size; no significance-based stopping or outcome-based exclusions
analysis.secondary: Reliability, runtime and baseline contrasts; kept separate from original primary study
analysis.confirmation_hypothesis: Projected method produces shorter paths on independent new environments; positive Cartesian-minus-projected differences
analysis.replay_note: Sensitivity rerun on the original environments, not another independent confirmation. Compare old/new per source environment; distinguish raised and reduced clearance cohorts.

preparation_note: Frozen deformations reused from invalidated attempt; complete measurement schedule restarted after verified scene restoration amendment.
